lines.beaver: 대표님, 새 사업 전략을 들어 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we hear the new business strategy?
lines.beaver_roman: Daepyonim, sae saeop jeollyageul deureo bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 농어촌 생산자와 직거래를 하려고 합니다.
lines.en: Yes, I plan to trade directly with rural producers.
lines.roman: Ne, nongeochon saengsanjawa jikgeoraereul haryeogo hamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Direct trade? How will you build logistics?
lines.en: I'll build a distribution network at each origin.
Not only labor costs, but logistics costs will drop too.

lines.beaver_en: Then will you cut factory operations too?
lines.en: No, the factory will keep running.

lines.beaver_en: Still, won't we be short on products?
lines.en: We'll increase output by improving varieties.

lines.beaver_en: Will you also work with industries other than farming?
lines.en: We'll work with fishing and forestry alike.

lines.learner: 그건 어렵지만 대신 경공업 벤처와 손잡겠습니다.
lines.en: That's hard, but we'll team up with light-industry ventures instead.
lines.roman: Geugeon eoryeopjiman daesin gyeonggongeop bencheowa sonjapgetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Will it help local communities too?
lines.en: It creates jobs and also contributes to self-sufficiency.

lines.beaver_en: How do you plan to do promotions?
lines.learner: 사업주들과 함께 판촉 행사를 열 겁니다.
lines.en: We'll hold promotional events with business owners.
lines.roman: Saeopjudeulgwa hamkke panchok haengsareul yeol geomnida.

lines.beaver_en: Great. The plan has really matured.
lines.en: Yes, we'll put trust before profit.
